title: Long-Distance Movers in Glendale | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Comparing the best long distance moving companies in Glendale? SOS Moving quotes interstate moves flat, with one licensed crew from loading day to delivery.
heroSubtitle: Flat-rate interstate moves out of Glendale, loaded and delivered by one licensed SOS crew.

faq.question: Do you charge by the hour for a long-distance move out of Glendale?
faq.answer: No. Interstate jobs are quoted flat, against the volume of the home, the route and the access at both ends. Hourly crew rates apply to local work only. A $50 deposit holds your date and comes off the final total.

faq.question: How long does delivery take after the truck leaves Glendale?
faq.answer: From several days, depending on the route, the season and road conditions. Because the truck carries your household alone, there are no other stops to wait on. The coordinator gives a delivery window once the route is set, and the driver keeps you posted while the load is moving. Nothing in that window depends on another customer’s schedule.

faq.question: What licenses should interstate moving companies in Glendale show me?
faq.answer: A USDOT number and an MC number, which together authorize a carrier to haul household goods across state lines. Ours are USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, plus CAL-T0192140 for moves that stay inside California. Both are public records you can look up before you call anyone. A company that will not hand them over on request is not the one to book.

faq.question: My building wants a certificate of insurance before loading day. Can you provide it?
faq.answer: Yes. A COI costs $50 and goes to the management company ahead of time, not on the morning of the move. Tell us early if the building also requires a reserved elevator or loading zone, since those bookings carry their own lead time. Management usually answers that question in a single email.

faq.question: Can you move a piano and other heavy items out of a Glendale home?
faq.answer: Yes. A piano is $200 and is only scheduled with a crew of four. Single items above 300 lbs are $150 with a crew of three. Both need to be on the inventory before the quote is finalized, because they change the crew size and not just the price. Name them when you first describe the home.

faq.question: What happens if the new home is not ready when the truck arrives?
faq.answer: For a short gap the load stays on the truck overnight for $200 and is delivered the next day. For a longer wait the household goes into storage and is redelivered once you have access. Flag it as early as you can, because a load that will be stored is packed to be unloaded twice. That is a decision made before loading, not on the day.
